description.narrative: The long-term objective of the project is to accelerate the development of sustainable tourism in Azerbaijan’s regions for the purpose of stimulating economic growth and improving community development.

condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

title.narrative: Conduct national market study of special interest tourism potential in Azerbaijan in the four priority tourism corridors

description.narrative: Situation analysis of special interest tourism in Azerbaijan (including supply and demand aspects, PESTEL , etc.) Consultations with relevant stakeholder groups using a close participatory approach at all levels Conducting market research surveys to support recommendations made in the analysis Developing Special Interest Tourism Market Study Report covering in detail the strongest/priority special interest tourism areas established from the initial analysis including (but not restricted to): Size and strength of market, Market segments, Consumer market demands and needs, Product gap analysis, Competitor destination analysis, Economic value and spending, Recommendations (for public and private sectors) Presentation of market analysis to STA/ATB and stakeholders at conclusion of activity

title.narrative: Develop a PPP/PPD structure, operational plan for DMO regions

description.narrative: Conducting diagnostic analysis of governance and management of tourism sector in regional areas of Azerbaijan that includes a comprehensive assessment of the political, environmental, socio-cultural, economic and legal environment Conducting analysis of successful sector knowledge/public-private partnership/dialog (PPP/PPD) structures in Azerbaijan in order to identify critical success factors, existing potential and opportunities for operation of a PPP/PPD structure. Establishing conceptual framework of a PPP/PPD structure that operates at a regional level the potential for a national umbrella that creates a sound framework for organising and co-ordinating regional tourism MSMEs, and regional and local tourism related public sector organisations and NGOs in Azerbaijan. Examining relevant laws and regulations, conducting interviews with relevant stakeholder groups in order to identify legal institutional structure for PPP/PPD. Developing PPP/PPD structure options and gathering feedback from key stakeholders through meetings and workshops. Finalising PPP/PPD structure based upon feedback gathered from key stakeholders. Developing PPP/PPD structure Operational Plan including (but not restricted to) aims, objectives and general vision, indictors and targets, organisational structure, duties, roles and functions, human resource management strategy, financial sustainability plan, etc. Assisting with implementation of PPP/PPD activities/actions through regional DMOs in accordance with the Strategic guiding action plan for PPP/PPD.

title.narrative: Number of DMO regions with Destination Management Plans

description.narrative: Conducting a diagnostic analysis that involves a comprehensive assessment of the destination market, attractions, products, etc., and a thorough assessment of tourism’s enabling environment and policies in each DMO region Establishing regional tourism stakeholder working groups in each DMO region who can provide input into the formulation of the DMPs (link to Activity 1.1) Establishing goal, vision and objectives for the five-year period for development of destination in each DMO region in collaboration with the working groups and other key stakeholders such as STA/ATB Reviewing diagnostic analysis and creating strategies and actions for developing the destination that link to each defined objective including the provision of land use plans for recommended strategies and actions. Conducting validation workshop/receiving feedback from tourism stakeholder working groups to review, refine and finalise DMP content. Presenting final DMP to key stakeholders in handover event with participation of media.

title.narrative: Implement regional tourism and hospitality training programme

description.narrative: Conducting meetings with STA/ATB and relevant tourism training providers to agree on training courses. Based on findings of STA Training Needs Analysis results as well as any further priorities of STA/ATB and suggestions of other relevant public and private sector stakeholders, finalise priority training course programmes (applying a partnership approach for delivery of programme where possible). There will be at least 4 occupation-based training courses in one location in each of the four tourism corridors (20 hours and not less than 15 hours per training event). The training should apply interactive/active learning principles and approaches, multimedia, and presentations from people in tourism who are a “success story”. The training will also include a topic on the importance of registration for legal employment, benefits and procedures. A system/strategy for evaluating training effectiveness will also be developed. Developing a training pack (trainer slides, trainer manual, trainer guide, handouts, evaluation form, etc.), implement training of trainers course, update and finalise materials based on trainer feedback. Working with industry associations and other key stakeholder groups to identify/register participants in each of the four courses for training and implement pilot training programme in the one selected destination. Collecting and analysing feedback from participants and trainers and finalise full training programme Implementing full training programme that consists of 4 training events (20 hours and not less than 15 hours each) for each of the three remaining tourism corridors (i.e., total of 16 training events). Providing a final report that compiles all information relating to the delivery of the training programme as well as a critical analysis of the strengths and weaknesses of the programme and recommendations for follow-up.

title.narrative: Implement tourism infrastructure development plans for priority Azerbaijan nature trails

description.narrative: Developing construction and statutory / non-statutory graphical layout sheets for all trail infrastructure, as well as estimations on the cost of production and installation Supporting STA/ATB to obtain all necessary permissions for implementing trail infrastructure improvements based upon existing STA/ATB trail plans Manufacturing the infrastructure (e.g. WC, benches, fencing, signs, viewing platform, etc.) according to STA/ATB’s technical drawings Reviewing and improving infrastructure design based on feedback from STA/ATB Installing infrastructure along the nature trails according to STA/ATB trail plans Implementing awareness/training programme for local authorities on management and maintenance of new infrastructure

title.narrative: Establish and implement a framework of four regional festivals

description.narrative: Developing festival/event concept for each of four festivals (one in each priority corridor) as well as existing festivals that connect to the unique positioning of each region including objectives, programme, budget, partners, public-private partnership strategy, etc. Identifying and securing festival/event location, participants and sponsors for one festival in each of the four corridors. Obtaining all necessary approvals/permissions from relevant public authorities for each of the four festivals. Creating and implementing a festival/event brand and marketing plan for each of the four festivals. Implementing and managing on-ground activities during each of the four event/festivals.

title.narrative: Support the MTC in participatory strategic planning process

description.narrative: Establishing a permanent PPP advisory board involving regional tourism industry, relevant government authorities and members of civil society who will provide input and monitor performance of MTC based upon its strategic plan. Preparing a four-year Strategic Plan for MTC based on situational analysis (covering such dimension as marketing, HR, finance, operation, organisational structure – including career and communication, international relations, quality management, exam and monitoring, etc.)

title.narrative: Implement tourism iInfrastructure development plans for priority Azerbaijan nature trails

description.narrative: Identifying priority tourism sites within each corridor and supporting STA/ATB to obtain necessary permissions to install safety signage infrastructure into proposed tourism sites Drafting content for safety related signs based upon analysis of safety issues in priority sites Developing construction and statutory/non-statutory graphical layout sheets for all safety related signs, as well as estimations on the cost of production and installation Reviewing and improving tourism site safety sign designs based on feedback from STA/ATB, site managers and any other relevant authorities Manufacturing the tourism site safety signs according to the graphical layout sheets Installing safety signs in the priority tourism sites

title.narrative: Number of villagers who are aware of the essentials of tourism, sex-disaggregated

description.narrative: Implement regional tourism awareness raising programme for: (1) local communities, (2) potential tourism entrepreneurs, and (3) businesses that could diversify into tourism. The scope of work will include: Analysing and identifying with guidance of STA/ATB the most critical tourism villages requiring tourism awareness raising needs and strongest opportunities to benefit from tourism. Working with municipalities and local government at the local and rayon level as well as other relevant stakeholders to identify participants in each village for awareness raising. Developing awareness raising programme paying close attention to integrating interactive/active learning principles and approaches as well as development of participant feedback form. Implementing pilot awareness raising programme for the 3 topics in 1 village. Collecting and analysing feedback from participants and trainers and finalise full awareness raising programme Implementing 24 awareness raising courses (3 courses x 2 destinations x 4 corridors, less courses completed in piloting programme). Prviding a final report that compiles all information relating to the delivery of the awareness raising programme as well as a critical analysis of the strengths and weaknesses of the programme and recommendations for follow-up.

Implementing awareness campaign between local stakeholders and tourism industry and accepting of applications. Conducting regional meetings with potential start-up participants for selection to incubation programme. Updating and implementing the mentorship/training programme on complimentary business start-up topics for innovation programme. 2Developing criteria and implementing evaluations of startup participants business concept booklets; Selecting top 20 start-uppers. Developing simple startup marketing materials for top 20 startup programme winners. Holding startup programme PR event with tourism industry and media. Procuring of prizes for winners, equipment, promo materials, etc., for startup programme. Supporting startupers to obtain legal employment status as individual entrepreneurs. Continuously monitor and provide advisory services to the business owners to ensure business viability.

title.narrative: Support MTC’s organizational development and upgrade of educational content, facilities and infrastructure

description.narrative: Preparing the Training Strategy and delivery of trainings to the MTC administrative staff members based on internal organizational situational analysis. Developing curriculum for core tourism qualifications (including development of syllabus, training material, presentations, etc.) and ensuring 70 percent adaptation for a dual degree study programme Developing and implementing TOT programme to strengthen the performance of MTC academic staff. Diagnosing infrastructure and equipment needs (including ICT) for MTC, establishing practical laboratories based on qualifications offered by college, and upgrading of existing building facilities and developing IT solutions.

title.narrative: Implement tourism infrastructure to improve tidiness and beautify key tourism places in at least 10 sites along the four priority tourism corridors.

description.narrative: Supporting STA/ATB to obtain all necessary permissions for implementing the tidy town infrastructure improvements according to STA/ATB priority locations Manufacturing the infrastructure (e.g. WC, benches, fencing, signs, etc.) according to STA/ATB’s technical drawings Reviewing and improving infrastructure design based on proposals from STA/ATB Installing infrastructure in the priority tourism sites Implementing awareness/training programme for local authorities on management and maintenance of new infrastructure

title.narrative: 3.4 Implement tourism infrastructure to improve facilities of regional tourism MSME

description.narrative: Working with STA/ATB to assess regional tourism MSMEs along priority tourism corridors who may be recipients of in-kind upgrades and identify specific upgrades that will be provided based upon available budget Working with STA/ATB to develop monitoring and sustainability plan for this kind of support (including contract/agreement between STA/ATB/Project and beneficiary) Installing upgrades (e.g. WCs, beds, kitchens, safety criteria, electrical, windows, roofing, etc.) for selected regional MSMEs Implementing monitoring and sustainability plan to ensure proper use of upgrades
